notes.title: Small Patch!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, hope you are well. Got a couple fixes here.


 Fixed bug that caused truck to move while using the Monster-Mulcher.
 Fixed problem with Level 3 Sprint being too slow.
 Quickened zombie spawn in farmhouse level.

Hope you have fun. If anyone finds any problems, please leave them in the discussions, and I'll fix them right away. Thanks!
